trap.label: phrasal verb literal
trap.right: We can get by with less.
trap.why: Traduzir “virar-se/passar” palavra por palavra leva a verbos errados. Em inglês, get by = conseguir se virar; get across = fazer entender.

mcq.q: I want to ___ our point across.

fix.wrong: I can’t get across to him the idea.
fix.right: I can’t get the idea across to him.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com get across: “I explained my idea clearly.”
Reescreva com get by: “We manage with little money.”
rewrite.answer: We get by with little money.
